note: June 1 - July 31, 1976-2025, from ERA5 hourly 10 m wind at a point on the route in each marine forecast area. An event is a run of hours at small craft strength or more (gaps up to 6 h merged, at least 2 h); its level is the highest it reached. corrected: ERA5 scaled by the buoy/ERA5 ratio of 95th percentile daily maximum wind where a MEDS buoy is in the area (else as era5_raw). buoy_observed: the buoy itself. nws_issued_2005_on: the warnings the US National Weather Service actually issued. Thresholds: small craft 20 kn (Canada) / 23 kn (US), gale 34 kn, storm 48 kn. Times Pacific daylight time.
